relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP treatment significantly increased the H3K9ac protein level in astroglial cells in a time‐dependent manner with a maximal effect observed after 6 h.

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, CGRP treatment significantly increased the GFAP protein level in astroglial cells after CGRP treatment for 4 and 6 h (Figure 4D).

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP treatment also significantly increased CX3CR1 and IL‐1β protein levels in the dorsal quadrant of L4‐L5 spinal segment ipsilateral to the operation side on postoperative days 5 and 7, respectively, compared with sham groups

relationships.subject: CGRP8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with CCI alone, CCI with AA and CGRP8‐37 markedly reversed the CCI induced the increase of H3K9ac protein expression (Figure 3B–E).

relationships.subject: CGRP8-37
relationships.evidence_quote: Compared with CCI alone, MWT and TWL in CCI + AA and CCI + CGRP8‐37 groups were significantly higher than those of both in CCI group on postoperative days 3–10 (p < 0.05; n = 6).

key_findings: CGRP increases H3K9ac in spinal astrocytes, raising CX3CR1 and IL-1β; CGRP antagonist and HAT inhibitor attenuate CCI hyperalgesia.
